sources.quote: Beta-i · Collaborative Innovation · Innovation that gets delivered collaborative innovation Home On this page What you can expect Our approach Track record Numbers Our work Beyond one organisation Coalitions Your challenges Where to start What we do Three models What we do Work Cases by model Strategic direction Operating model Corporate venturing All of it Every case Searchable Who we are Careers Share your challenge Beta-i · Collaborative innovation Innovation that gets delivered . We work side by side with teams to turn innovation into measurable results. And when the problem is bigger than one company, as a global leader in collaborative innovation, we orchestrate the coalitions that deliver. Share your challenge See our track record Some of the organisations we have worked with What you can expect From innovation ambition to operational results . The teams we work with want more projects to reach operations. We work side by side to make that happen, and measure our contribution by the results we achieve together. 01 Strategy connected to delivery We involve the teams responsible for procurement and operations from the start, so the strategy reflects what implementation will require. 02 A clear path from pilot to deployment We design pilots with your teams around clear success criteria, ownership and the decisions needed to move towards deployment. 03 Experienced teams
